Q8-001.question_or_metric: Mandalika MotoGP total spectators: 140,324 per Polri (repeating the organiser count, not an official Polri count); minister statement of about 142,000 noted separately
Q8-001.notes: MERGED Q8-001 + Q8-002 (same count in two forms): MGPA organiser count 140,324 (kontan, katadata, ekon.go.id, GNFI 2025-10-08, databoks 2025-10-06); minister statement quoted as 142,000 (Antara, Republika 2025-10-05), Detik quotes "140 ribu". 2026 edition later reported 157,875, so this is a 2025 value, not the latest. Run 1b (2026-10-16): opened https://inp.polri.go.id/artikel/motogp-mandalika-2025-spectators-reached-140000 ; https://mataram.antaranews.com/berita/494029/indonesia-2025-mandalika-motogp-draws-142000-spectators-thohir ; databoks (BEH-029); printed date Polri "Selasa, 07 Oktober 2025"; Antara "Senin, 6 Oktober 2025 05:17 WIB"; Databoks 2025-10-06. Both numbers confirmed in the opened pages. Polri repeats the organiser's count; Databoks carries 140,324 as an increase of "15.73% compared to 2024 and 36.24% compared to ... 2023". Antara dated 6 Oct (not 5 Oct as in the register; the minister spoke on Sunday 5 Oct). Neither ITDC nor MGPA was opened directly. Polri repeats the organiser count (140,324); Antara quotes the minister at about 142 thousand and is dated 6 Oct, not 5 Oct. Neither ITDC nor MGPA was opened directly. Audit follow-up (2026-10-17): Label fix: Polri repeats the organiser (MGPA) count and does not call it its own; the minister figure (about 142,000, Antara) is a different statement kept only as a note. Polri page reopened: "attendance of 140,324 spectators". No figure changed.
